text: The Manager, Traffic Operations, Transportation Services will give a presentation on Accessibility at Construction Sites.

The Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee recommends to the Executive Committee that: 1. The General Manager, Transportation Services be requested to review the comments and recommendations in the submission (April 18, 2018) from Walk Toronto, Steering Committee and report to the Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee in the first quarter of 2019 on the feasibility of implementing the recommendations.
